claims.title: Posterior support cell and remaining budget are sufficient for deterministic adaptive Boolean coordinate queries
claims.scope: finite Boolean hidden models with exact deterministic coordinate queries and Bayesian terminal coding loss
assumptions: query outcomes are deterministic functions of the hidden bit string
future admissible queries depend only on the current cell and remaining budget
nonclaims: support-cell sufficiency is not asserted for noisy or history-dependent query channels, where the full posterior is the state

claims.title: Exact adaptive Boolean query value obeys the finite Bellman recursion over posterior cells
assumptions: terminal loss is posterior minority probability
nonclaims: the bounded solver is not asserted polynomial-time
restricting to strictly splitting coordinates is a lemma (a non-splitting query only spends budget), not an extra assumption

claims.title: Adaptive query value weakly dominates the best nonadaptive subset at the same budget
claims.scope: the same Boolean prior, terminal loss, and query budget
assumptions: an adaptive controller may ignore outcomes and emulate any fixed query subset

claims.title: A zero-myopic-value query can have positive finite-horizon option value
claims.scope: existence statement; witness: uniform three-bit multiplexer (ST-M61)
assumptions: experiment scheduling may depend on earlier observed outcomes
nonclaims: does not assert that every adaptive problem has a zero-myopic-value query with positive option value

claims.title: Three-bit multiplexer has exact two-query adaptivity gain one quarter
claims.scope: uniform three-bit multiplexer with two free exact coordinate queries
assumptions: f(x)=x1 when x0=0 and x2 when x0=1
nonclaims: the value one quarter is specific to this finite construction

claims.title: Three-bit parity has no adaptive query advantage before full information
claims.scope: uniform three-bit parity with budgets zero through three
nonclaims: other Boolean functions may have strict adaptivity gain

claims.title: Bounded exact adaptive Boolean query audit
claims.scope: multiplexer option value, nonadaptive comparison, budget monotonicity, majority, and parity boundary tests
assumptions: all priors and Bellman values use exact rational arithmetic
nonclaims: bounded tests are not a scalability theorem
CI success is not evidence for simulation
